title: P2 pixel chain (P): material/ID-driven downscale with limb protection, overlap separation and temporal locking for the skinned rig
question: Owner, round 1: 'limbs like legs sometimes flicker and disappear ... I still see disconnected parts like legs, thighs.' Can the 3D->pixel step keep legs from vanishing, separate overlapping legs, connect the thighs to the skirt (skin band + red sock top), and stay frame-to-frame stable (pxeval boil <= .02, shade_swap <= .015, no FEET_JITTER)?
method: render/pixel_chain.py (replaces E2 k-centroid -> palette lock -> fix): per-cell vote over matid x part (part = dominant deform bone from my extra pass render/p_parts.py, run through R's render_motion.py), outline drawn outside an eroded fill, legs/hands guaranteed >= 2 px (skeleton cells + 2x2 growth), 1 px far-side K line between leg.L|leg.R and arm|body overlaps (near side if the far limb would thin), 2-value skirt, red sock-top row guaranteed, near-leg d stripe + g rim, far leg one step darker; head from R's projected-master tex pass (texel-phase aligned). Temporal: exact surface correspondence from a rest-position pass -> hysteresis on fill/label/band, surface-locked shades, head hold, 1-frame flip removal, loops run twice. render/p2_run.sh runs passes + parts + chain + a round-1-chain baseline on the same passes.
result: pxeval (same passes; round-1 chain -> P2): walk SE boil .021->.016, shade_swap .029->.038 (P2 rig-head variant .024); walk S boil .023->.015, swap .036->.027, feet 9->2; idle SE/E/S boil .011->.007/.008/.006, swap .025-.027->.027/.026/.017; run and jump still boil .03-.13 (limb motion > 2 px/frame). Round 1 as shipped (walk SE, stamp): boil .056, swap .047. No FROZEN/STIFF (articulation 2.5-4.5/s walk/run, ~1/s idle). 74% of walk SE shade swaps sit on surfaces moving > 2.5 px/frame (dark keys K/D/h/H/d all within dE 12); the tex head adds ~.01 swap when the head rotates. FEET_JITTER in SE/E is real 30-degree stride perspective (~7 px); the SE walk forward sole clips 1 row at the cell bottom.
verdict: Opus 6.5 vs 4.5 and Argon 7.2 vs 3.4 (P2 vs round 1 shipped): legs never vanish and the thighs are connected (Opus thigh connection 8 vs 3). Not at the gates yet: shade_swap fails everywhere and boil fails on run/jump/walk E. Further gains need in-betweens or holds (M) and a quantised head turn (R/M). Still open: passing-pose legs (g rim added after the last critique), tent-like skirt hem with stair-stepped corners, a skin wedge that changes size, square boot toes.
